notes.title: CV review slots this week
notes.text: INSEAD is running CV and cover letter reviews with a career coach for anyone applying before 15 November, and your Amazon Pathways task is dated the 15th. The sessions are 22, 23 and 26 October by sector, and they want a VMock-formatted CV, which you have as of yesterday. - Sign up for one slot only.

notes.itemTitle: [NEWS] Apply to Amazon Pathways (MBA Operations LDP)
notes.title: Amazon session, 2 November
notes.text: Amazon is running an info session on 2 November about the Pathways Leadership Internship, with the registration link in this morning's Pre-MBA newsletter. INSEAD notes their recruiting is rolling, so roles close as they fill rather than on a deadline. - Worth applying soon after the session rather than waiting for the date on this task.
